categories.main_business_segments: Dynagreen Environmental Protection Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the municipal waste-to-energy sector, focusing on investment, construction, operation, maintenance, and technical consulting of waste-to-energy plants under BOT and other concession models. The company also engages in related environmental protection services including heating and steam supply, sludge treatment, and hazardous waste treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes self-developed multiple drive expeller grate waste incinerators with a unique integrated three-stage design for waste incineration. It employs advanced flue gas purification systems including denitration, lime deacidification, activated carbon injection, bag filters, and SCR technology. The company also pursues digital transformation and artificial intelligence applications for operational efficiency and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dynagreen's primary customers are municipal administrative authorities of local governments who contract waste treatment services, and power grid companies that purchase electricity generated from waste incineration. The company serves urban and county-level markets across China, providing waste treatment and renewable energy solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with projects in over 20 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions including economically developed regions such as the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Bohai Economic Rim, as well as central and western regions like Anhui, Hubei, Guizhou, Shanxi, Guangxi, Jiangxi, Henan, and Sichuan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dynagreen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the waste-to-energy supply chain. It procures equipment and construction services upstream through tenders and focuses on waste treatment and power generation downstream, providing services to local governments and selling electricity to power grids.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation, including ultra-low emission flue gas treatment, digital transformation, and AI applications in waste incineration management. It focuses on quality and efficiency enhancement, cost reduction, expanding heating and steam supply businesses, and actively participates in green certificate trading. The company also plans to implement a restricted A-share incentive scheme to align management interests with long-term development.
categories.revenue_model: Dynagreen generates revenue mainly from waste treatment fees paid by local governments under concession agreements and electricity sales to power grid companies at regulated tariffs. Additional income comes from steam and heating supply, construction services during project development, and green certificate trading.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dynagreen is a leading player in China's waste-to-energy industry, with 37 projects under operation and a treatment capacity exceeding 40,000 tons per day, ranking it among the top in terms of project number and capacity. The company benefits from extensive industry experience, proprietary technology, and a broad geographic footprint, positioning it strongly against competitors in a stable and mature market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dynagreen reported revenue of approximately RMB3.4 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB585 million, with a slight year-on-year decrease due to fewer projects under construction. The company maintains total assets of about RMB22 billion and a gearing ratio of 61.21%. Operational indicators such as waste treated, electricity generated, and steam supplied reached record highs, reflecting steady growth and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dynagreen offers integrated waste-to-energy solutions combining environmental protection with energy generation, leveraging patented incineration technology tailored to Chinese municipal waste characteristics. Its commitment to ultra-low emissions, digital and AI-driven operations, and comprehensive service from construction to operation differentiates it by enhancing efficiency, environmental compliance, and shareholder value through stable cash flows and dividend policies.
